later_or_conflicting_evidence.meeting_title: Marc / Kobi - 2026/07/09 10:00 EDT - Notes by Gemini
later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: The team decided to deprioritize the request for separate console tabs for each account list view.

Emily Vandenberg: you need quick buttons for like my signups like my redeposits versus that drop down / Emily Vandenberg: So like getting out of the gate, we would preconfigure October and then like we could do October Ontario, October Alberta.

variances.what_differs: On 7/7 Kobi told WagerTech that Jumpr would add console tabs so users could click into, for example, a full list of Operators. Jira closed the navigation spike on 7/29 with the standard console and no tabs. The only record of the deprioritization is an internal Gemini note, and no client meeting confirms it.
variances.suggested_action: Suggestion only: confirm in a weekly sync that the record-type list views meet the 7/7 'Operators tab' expectation, or reopen WAGR-310 / WAGR-38. Emily's 9/30 ask for quick navigation buttons (L3330) shows navigation is still a live topic.
variances.reasoning: The 7/7 statement is tier1 and decided, and nothing later in the ledger walks it back with the client. The confidence is low because Operator/Partner list views may already meet the intent, and I could not verify the console navigation that is actually in place.
